stemMd: A horizontal spring with spring constant 200 N m⁻¹ is compressed by 0.10 m. How much elastic potential energy is stored?
explanationMd: Spring energy is one half kx². Substitution gives 0.5 × 200 × 0.10² = 1.0 J. The force rises from zero to 20 N during compression, so average force 10 N times 0.10 m also gives 1 J.

distractorRationale.c: This is the numerical spring force, not its stored energy.
distractorRationale.e: This uses compression to the first power.
distractorRationale.b: This introduces an extra factor of ten.
